sections.name: RIB_SEG5
sections.view: plate lists, H table (H2), section D-D

lessons: Arch-rib WEB PL widths are cut widths including the curvature of the segment; take the section depth from the H2 column of the height table or from the section view.
Arch-rib bottom flange (1574) sits between the webs; the top flange (1700) overhangs 50 mm each side.

The section view dimensions the web as 3@400=1200: the pitch is 400, so there are 2 horizontal web ribs per web (the flanges close the outer panels). Callout prefixes such as 4-RIB count pieces along the segment and over both webs.
